scope: Six assignments executed by one cluster researcher; six agents are not claimed.

01.hypothesis: The lawful universal object is a source-indexed execution span (original source <- admissible paths -> current carrier), equipped with a public-report quotient, epistemic fibers, and separately justified proof authority.
01.rival: One scalar state or untyped colimit can identify all these levels.
01.first_verdict: The untyped rival fails under destructive updates and ideal nonrealized profiles. A conditional universal property can be proved only for the declared public-report quotient, not all ontology.

02.hypothesis: Source-changing relational base change has two distinct lifting gates, each equivalent to all-predicate existential transport in one direction; universal transport follows by Boolean duality.
02.rival: A commuting observation square or observed-support descent suffices for all truth/evidence transport.
02.first_verdict: Small relation tables separate the two gates. Prior O600 concerns only forward observed supports; original-state posterior transport requires an additional target-fiber lifting gate.

03.hypothesis: Cumulative history partitions refine on one fixed path/source domain; current-carrier partitions need not refine after intervention. Truth-preserving retention is exactly a kernel inclusion.
03.rival: Every additional observation increases knowledge of every current or original-source claim.
03.first_verdict: The rival has a two-state reset countermodel. Appending records retains historical knowledge only under correct path/source typing.

04.hypothesis: Minimum pointwise proof support is a hitting set of target-disagreeing rivals, but support cardinality, physical cost, communicated evidence and macro-update count require distinct contracts.
04.rival: A universal knowledge-debt scalar bounds all four without specifying proof authority and cost semantics.
04.first_verdict: AND_n gives sharp n versus one certificates; scaling action cost and batching independently destroy claimed cross-metric bounds.

05.hypothesis: Finite-tool darkness is equality of all legal public traces, certified by a greatest action-stable equivalence; pathway and representation defects are independent of this equivalence.
05.rival: A failed search, missing decoder, or toolkit-extension witness alone establishes intrinsic impossibility.
05.first_verdict: A finite pair-state search yields either a separating word or a closed no-separation witness. Missing probe and faithful-source defects require separate comparisons.

06.hypothesis: For finitely many observers, fused information is the intersection of report kernels, whereas deterministic common information is their generated equivalence closure; neither determines conditional independence.
06.rival: Locally incomplete or mutually trivial common reports prevent global reconstruction.
06.first_verdict: Three-coordinate and parity-source examples sharply separate common information, fusion, pairwise independence and joint source realizability.
